concept.description: Labels methods running in a transaction (method or class level @Transactional) as :Transactional.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND NOT m:Constructor AND (EXISTS { MATCH (x)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(at:Type) WHERE (x = m OR x = t) AND at.fqn IN ['org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional', 'jakarta.transaction.Transactional', 'javax.transaction.Transactional'] }) SET m:Transactional RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS TransactionalMethods

concept.description: Labels methods running in a read-only transaction (@Transactional(readOnly = true)) as :ReadOnlyTransactional.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND NOT m:Constructor AND EXISTS { MATCH (x)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(at:Type), (a)-[:HAS]->(v:Value {name: 'readOnly'}) WHERE (x = m OR x = t) AND at.fqn IN ['org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional', 'jakarta.transaction.Transactional', 'javax.transaction.Transactional'] AND v.value = true } SET m:ReadOnlyTransactional RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS ReadOnlyTransactionalMethods

MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled', 'org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Schedules'] } SET m:ScheduledJob RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS ScheduledJobs

MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.context.event.EventListener', 'org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener'] } SET m:MessageConsumer, m.consumerKind = 'event' RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS EventListeners

concept.description: Labels @Async methods as :AsyncMethod and stores the executor name (property asyncExecutor).
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(v:Value {name: 'value'}) SET m:AsyncMethod, m.asyncExecutor = v.value RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS AsyncMethods

constraint.description: @Async must name a dedicated executor (and, when the parameter executorNames is set, one of the allowed pools), otherwise all concerns share one default pool.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:AsyncMethod) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (m.asyncExecutor IS NULL OR m.asyncExecutor = '' OR ($executorNames <> '' AND NOT m.asyncExecutor IN [x IN split($executorNames, ',') | trim(x)])) RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, coalesce(m.asyncExecutor, '<default pool>') AS Detail

group.description: tech-spring-core - Spring Framework core (transactions, scheduling, events, async)
